subject.title: Feature/Fix: Validate and optimize lineage token accounting

question: Should CodexBar adopt the four-PR lineage ledger as the permanent fork-accounting architecture, and if so how should its identity/cache work be reconciled with https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2118 before landing?
rationale: Both paths have strong proof and address the same user-visible overcount from different scopes, but choosing the permanent accounting model and stack order affects cache compatibility, future maintenance, and when lineage may become authoritative.

options.title: Reconcile then land the stack
options.body: First decide the narrow identity/cache behavior, rebase the four lineage PRs onto that result, remove overlapping mechanisms, and rerun exact-head upgrade and corpus proof before merging in order.

options.title: Adopt the lineage stack directly
options.body: Land https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2155 through this PR in order and intentionally supersede or narrow the overlapping implementation in https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2118.

options.title: Prefer narrow fixes for now
options.body: Land the smaller proven identity/cache correction and pause the lineage architecture until broader daily parity or a clearer promotion requirement justifies the additional surface.

recommendation.title: Reconcile then land the stack
recommendation.body: First decide the narrow identity/cache behavior, rebase the four lineage PRs onto that result, remove overlapping mechanisms, and rerun exact-head upgrade and corpus proof before merging in order.

likelyOwner.reason: This person merged and refined the current scanner containment path and is best positioned to choose the repository’s permanent accounting architecture and landing sequence.
